title: Tameable Golems
description: This mod adds the ability to tame iron golems with a poppy flower. When tamed, the golem will follow the player through the world to defend them.
body:
![The logo for tameable golems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23f49b8275ae7511f591e2387281e72daeaa83ad.png)
# Tameable Golems

Ever looked at an iron golem and thought, “I wish you’d follow me instead of hanging around that village all day”? Now they can.

With **Tameable Golems**, a simple poppy is all it takes to win the loyalty of these gentle giants. Right-click an untamed golem with the flower it loves, and it instantly becomes your devoted companion—your own walking, swinging, mob-punching bodyguard. Even if the mob you're fighting isn't as hostile as you are... (R.I.P. to those villagers)

Once tamed, the golem sticks with you. It charges at anything that hurts you, follows faithfully through forests and caves, and even sits on command when you need it to stay put. The Golem will also have a **Guard** mode, in this mode the Golem will actively patrol a 5x5 area for you.

No complicated breeding, no rare items, no taming chance that makes you waste a dozen poppies—just one flower, one click, and a new best friend who will throw hands with creepers the second they look at you funny.

The golem still feels like a golem: tough, loyal, and a bit slow on the turns. But now it’s your golem. Build a statue, pop a poppy in its hand, and set off on an adventure with a guardian that really hits back.
